definitions.explanation: An underground excavation for extracting coal.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{炭鉱|たんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: This town once prospered from coal mining.

examples.japanese: {炭鉱|たんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉山|へいざん}→閉山：28518_heizan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{炭鉱|たんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧。
examples.english: People who work in coal mines.

notes:
{炭鉱|たんこう} refers to coal mines and the coal mining industry.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {炭鉱|たんこう}⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧: coal miner
- {炭鉱|たんこう}⟦{夫|ふ}→夫：noentry⟧: coal miner (older term)
- {炭鉱|たんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: coal mining town
- ⟦{閉山|へいざん}→閉山：28518_heizan⟧: mine closure

ETYMOLOGY:
Japan had many coal mines, especially in Kyushu and Hokkaido, but most closed by the 1960s-70s as oil became the primary energy source.
